sections.name: Wolf, Goat and Cabbage
lines: N
A farmer must cross a river with a wolf, a goat and a cabbage.
A farmer must cross a river with a wolf, a goat and a cabbage.
N
His boat can carry only him and one of them at a time.
His boat can carry only him and one of them at a time.
N
Left alone, the wolf eats the goat, and the goat eats the cabbage.

lines.ask: How does he get all three across?

lines: How does he get all three across? You have 10 seconds. Think!
How does he get all three across? You have 10 seconds. Think!
N

lines.answer: Goat over. Wolf over,|bring the goat back.|Cabbage over. Goat over.

lines: Take the goat across first. Go back and take the wolf, but bring the goat back with you.
Take the goat across first. Go back and take the wolf, but bring the goat back with you.
N
Leave the goat, and take the cabbage across to the wolf. Finally, go back for the goat.
